input.quote: b) The total liability for either Party, regardless of the form of action, whether contract or tort, is limited to three percent (3%) of the value of the bill of materials contained in the Products delivered to IBM and IBM Customers by MSL in the period beginning with the Effective Date of the Agreement through the resolution of the action. .
input.rationale: Section 15.3 contains a mutual consequential-damages exclusion (a) and a mutual monetary cap (b), so mutuality is satisfied. However the cap fails the fallback on two material terms: (1) the basis is 3% of the bill-of-materials value of Products delivered over the whole term, not 12 months' fees — a small fraction of amounts payable and well below the 6-month floor; and (2) there are no carve-outs at all, so MSL's Section 15.1 indemnities (third-party IP infringement, legal non-compliance, warranty/support failure), confidentiality breaches, gross negligence and wilful misconduct all sit inside that 3% cap with no super-cap — expressly walk-away territory. Redline resets the cap to the greater of 12 months' amounts paid or payable and US$1,000,000 and adds an Excluded Claims sentence, keeping the clause mutual. Section 15 (Limitation of Remedies) and Section 13 of the Equipment and Program Loan Agreement run in IBM's favour as lender and are not flagged.

proposal.summary: Reset the 15.3(b) cap to the greater of 12 months' amounts paid/payable or US$1,000,000 and carve out indemnities, confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is a mutual cap at the greater of the amounts paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim and US$1,000,000, with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sitting outside the cap. A cap of 3% of bill-of-materials value that also swallows MSL's Section 15.1 indemnities leaves us without meaningful recourse on third-party infringement and compliance claims; if helpful, we can accept a straight 12-months cap provided the carve-outs remain.

ops.oldText: b) The total liability for either Party, regardless of the form of action, whether contract or tort, is limited to three percent (3%) of the value of the bill of materials contained in the Products delivered to IBM and IBM Customers by MSL in the period beginning with the Effective Date of the Agreement through the resolution of the action. .
ops.newText: b) Except for Excluded Claims, the total liability for either Party, regardless of the form of action, whether contract or tort, is limited to the greater of (i) the amounts paid or payable by IBM to MSL under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the action and (ii) one million U.S. dollars (US$1,000,000). "Excluded Claims" means a Party's indemnification obligations, breach of its confidentiality obligations, gross negligence, willful misconduct or fraud, and infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights; liability for Excluded Claims, and IBM's obligation to pay amounts due for Products, are not subject to the limitation in this Section 15.3 b).
